title: Philemon
author: Paul the apostle.
audience: Philemon, Apphia, Archippus, and the church in Philemon's house.
historicalSetting: Paul appeals for Onesimus to be received not merely as a servant but as a beloved brother.
keyVerse: Philemon 1:16 — "No longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother."
christFocus: Philemon reflects the reconciling work of Christ, who receives sinners and makes enemies into family through grace.
